about: A person signs in with Google and uploads a video, with no SDK (the demand's callers use fetch): the application sends the World's person to Google's authorize page (the googleoauth twin's account chooser) with the YouTube scopes and offline access, the person chooses their account (the chooser's form, posted as the browser posts it), the code is traded at Google's token endpoint for an access token and a refresh token, the person's channel is read (channels.list mine=true, YOUTUBE_CHANNEL_ID), a video is uploaded by the resumable protocol (201, uploaded) and, with the access token the refresh token renews, read back processed. GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET and YOUTUBE_API_KEY are googleoauth's credential door's (the application's OAuth client with its loopback redirect http://localhost:3000/oauth2callback, the World's person, and the project's API key, as Google Cloud's Credentials page issues them); YOUTUBE_CHANNEL_ID is YouTube's (that person's channel, its sign-up). Readback reads the video with the API key, writing nothing, and finds its title, channel and processed status.
